verdict.rationale: Runloop documents an official MCP server (ai-tools page, confirmed by probe) that lets LLMs/agents pull Runloop API context, and separately an 'MCP Hub' for giving agents access to MCP tool servers without exposing credentials. This shows a real, documented MCP server offering, but the evidence is thin—no detailed setup guide, transport details, or independent confirmation of hands-on connection success. Missing for 10: detailed MCP server documentation/setup steps, independent/hands-on verification of connecting an agent to it, and clarity on tool coverage.
